title: Scientists Built Transistors From Living Bacteria
mediaSource: MIT living bacterial transistors circuit board 2026

scenes.title: A computer circuit made from bacteria
scenes.narration: MIT researchers engineered bacteria to behave like transistors, creating living circuits from colonies of cells.

scenes.title: They switch chemical signals instead of electric current
scenes.narration: Like electronic transistors control current, these bacterial switches detect molecules and turn downstream chemical signals on or off.

scenes.title: Colonies were wired together like a circuit board
scenes.narration: The team placed different bacterial colonies at controlled distances so molecules could carry information from one colony to the next.

scenes.title: The living circuits could perform calculations
scenes.narration: Researchers combined the bacterial switches and relays to process several inputs and route information through the biological circuit.

scenes.title: They could become environmental sensors
scenes.narration: Future versions could potentially live on plant surfaces or roots, sensing nearby conditions and sending useful biological signals.

scenes.title: Biology itself is becoming computing hardware
scenes.narration: Instead of silicon, living cells are now being connected into information-processing circuits, blurring the line between computers and organisms.
